bio.title: Bio
bio.description: Background, education, and current research direction.
bio.paragraph1: I am Yuqian Zhang, a first-year MScAC student at the University of Toronto. My work sits at the intersection of computational physics, biology, general inverse problems, and computer graphics.
bio.paragraph2: My research centers on mathematical modelling, physics-driven and computational methods, deep learning, and computer graphics. I have worked on spatial transcriptomics denoising with graph variational auto-encoders, Neural-ODE-based gene expression field estimation, ocean surface representation learning with transformers, and Bayesian-PINN-Kalman hybrids for time-series inverse problems
bio.nowValue: First-year MScAC student, University of Toronto.
